description: Bundle-size budget for scripts/check-bundle-size.js (roadmap W10.1). `targets` are the budgets the gate was written with; the bundle has never met them. `ceilings` are the measured sizes on 2026-10-01 (vendor-map 2598 KB, index 726 KB, total 10758 KB) plus ~2% headroom, so the gate can block in CI today: growth past a ceiling fails, and a ceiling more than 5% above what is measured fails too, until it is lowered. Ceilings only go DOWN — DEFECT-0027 (the schema chunk in the client bundle) is the first planned reduction. A chunk named here is keyed by its Vite name, without the content hash.
